Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release

analysis.summary: RBZ Jewellers Limited reported a strong first quarter for fiscal 2027, with revenue from operations growing 60% year-on-year to INR121 crores and EBITDA increasing 39% year-on-year to INR18 crores at a 14.9% margin. Management highlighted ongoing retail expansion plans, including four new store launches across Surat, Rajkot, Gandhinagar, and Maninagar in the upcoming quarters. The company also discussed its long-term strategic shift towards increasing its retail share in the revenue mix and gradually adopting Gold Metal Loans for hedging. RBZ Jewellers Limited released its Q1FY27 investor presentation, reporting an operational revenue of INR 1,208 million and a PAT of INR 91 million. Management highlighted ongoing retail showroom expansion plans across Gujarat, including upcoming stores in Surat, Rajkot, Gandhinagar, and Maninagar.

guidance.claim: The company expects the B2B to B2C mix to reach 50-50 in a year or two and 75-25 in the long term, with 75% being retail.
guidance.quote: the mix has to, I think the B2B to B2C mix has to be 50-50 or so in a year or two and in long term it will be 75-25, 75 being retail.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the demand side looks to be good and promising for Quarter 2.
demand_outlook.quote: And the demand side looks to be good and promising for Quarter 2, as we are approaching.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that Q2 performance is anticipated to be in line with earlier commentaries due to order backing from IIJS.
demand_outlook.quote: I think Quarter 2, we think that because of the orders and all, we are hoping that performance will be very much in line with whatever we have projected in earlier commentaries.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that revenue increased year-on-year driven by robust customer demand, higher jewellery sales, and strengthening brand recall.
demand_outlook.quote: Revenue increased by ~60% year-on-year, driven by robust customer demand, higher jewellery sales, and strengthening brand recall.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that they continue to witness steady consumer demand in the occasion wear segment ahead of the wedding season.
demand_outlook.quote: We continue to witness steady consumer demand in occasion wear segment ahead of the wedding season, while also optimizing our inventory mix with a greater focus on lightweight and budget-friendly product offering to cater to evolving consumer preference.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that April business has been very good.

capex_expansion.claim: Surat store will launch in Quarter 2.
capex_expansion.quote: Okay. So, Surat will be launching in Quarter 2 and Rajkot in early Quarter 3.

capex_expansion.claim: Rajkot, Maninagar, and Gandhinagar stores will be launched in Quarter 3.
capex_expansion.quote: And same, I think Maninagar and Gandhinagar both will be launched in Quarter 3 itself. So three stores in Quarter 3 and one store in Quarter 2, that is Surat.

capex_expansion.claim: Large format stores have a carpet area of around 10,000 square feet and mid format stores have 5,000 square feet.
capex_expansion.quote: The large format stores are typically around 10,000 square feet carpet area and mid format stores are 5,000 square feet carpet area.

capex_expansion.claim: Inventory deployment in large format stores is typically around INR125 crores to INR150 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: The inventory deployment in large format stores is typically around INR125 crores to INR150 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: Inventory deployment in small format stores is around INR50 crores, plus and minus 10% to 15%.
capex_expansion.quote: While in small format stores are around INR50 crores, plus and minus 10%, 15%.

capex_expansion.claim: The capex break-even for the stores is expected to be achieved in a year or less.
capex_expansion.quote: The capex when you say about the break-even point, the capex break-even will be achieved in a year or less.

capex_expansion.claim: Retail expansion remains on track with flagship showrooms in Surat and Rajkot alongside mid-sized stores in Maninagar and Gandhinagar.
capex_expansion.quote: Retail expansion remains on track, with flagship showrooms in Surat (by Q2) and Rajkot (by early Q3), alongside mid-sized stores in Maninagar (Ahmedabad East) and Gandhinagar, aimed at strengthening geographic presence and enhancing direct customer access across high-growth Gujarat markets.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is planning to expand its retail presence in Rajkot, Surat, and Ahmedabad.
capex_expansion.quote: We are also planning to expand our retail presence in Rajkot, Surat and Ahmedabad as well.

capex_expansion.claim: Both showrooms in Surat and Rajkot are targeted to commence operations by the second quarter of fiscal year 2027.
capex_expansion.quote: On the retail front, encouraged by the strong performance of our Ahmedabad store, we are now planning to expand in other key Gujarat markets, including Surat and Rajkot, both the showrooms are targeted to commence operations by quarter 2 of FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is actively exploring strategic locations in Eastern Ahmedabad and nearby cities such as Gandhinagar for mid-sized stores of around 5,000 square feet.
capex_expansion.quote: Further, we are actively exploring strategic location in Eastern Ahmedabad and nearby cities such as Gandhinagar for mid-sized stores of around 5,000 square feet and aimed at strengthening the regional presence and driving incremental growth.

margins_costs.claim: Revenue from operations for Q1 FY27 stood at INR121 crores, registering a 60% year-on-year growth.
margins_costs.quote: For the quarter under review, revenue from operations stood at INR121 crores registering a strong growth of 60% Y-o-Y with a revenue growth in line with the guidance shared in the previous quarter, driven by robust consumer demand, higher jewellery sales and strengthening brand recall.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA for the quarter was INR18 crores reflecting a growth of 39% year-on-year, with EBITDA margins at 14.9%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the quarter is INR18 crores reflecting a healthy growth of 39% Y-o-Y, with EBITDA margins coming in a healthy 14.9%.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax for the quarter was INR9 crores translating PAT to 7.5%.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after tax for the quarter has been 28% at INR9 crores translating PAT at 7.5%.

margins_costs.claim: Retail revenue stood at INR78 crores, registering a 70% year-on-year growth, and wholesale revenue stood at 42% reflecting a 47% year-on-year growth.
margins_costs.quote: In terms of segmental performance for the quarter, retail revenue stood at INR78 crores registering a robust 70% Y-o-Y growth. Wholesale revenue stood at 42% reflecting a strong 47% Y-o-Y growth.

margins_costs.claim: Amortization of lease assets is INR76 lakhs and the impact of lease liabilities is at INR115 lakhs.
margins_costs.quote: The amortization of lease assets is INR76 lakhs and the impact of lease liabilities is at INR115 lakhs.

margins_costs.claim: For the full financial year 2026, EBITDA margins improved to 14.44% with an expansion of 233 basis points.
margins_costs.quote: For the financial year 2026, revenue from operations stood at INR637 crores, reflecting the growth of 20% year-on-year. EBITDA for the year increased significantly by 43% to INR92 crores, with EBITDA margins improving to 14.44% and expansion of 233 basis points.

orders_capacity.claim: Total factory capacity remains at around 1.8 to 2 tons a year.
orders_capacity.quote: The total capacity still remains at around 1.8 to 2 tons a year.

orders_capacity.claim: Factory consumption or production is somewhere around 900 kgs to 1000 kgs, utilizing the factory at around 50% capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: And the production that we are doing or the consumption that we are able to do is somewhere around 900 kgs to 1000 kgs. So, we are utilizing factory at around 50% of capacity.

orders_capacity.claim: The company targets maximum utilisation of existing manufacturing capacity by FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: Targeting maximum utilisation of existing manufacturing capacity by FY26

orders_capacity.claim: During the quarter, the company launched 730 new designs averaging 8 designs per day primarily in the occasion wear segment.
orders_capacity.quote: During the quarter, we launched 730 new designs averaging 8 designs per day, primarily in occasion wear segment further strengthening our product portfolio
The capacity utilization is approximately 50% or 55%.

capital_allocation.claim: The company has a sanctioned debt of around INR300 crores which is yet to be utilized.
capital_allocation.quote: Given that we have a sanctioned debt of around INR300 crores. And we are yet to utilize it, which is sufficient for the four stores that is coming in this financial year.

capital_allocation.claim: By the end of the financial year, the debt-to-equity ratio will still be below 1:1, estimated at around 0.8 debt to 1 equity.
capital_allocation.quote: By the end of this financial year, we will be still below 1:1 ratio. I guess 0.8 will be debt and 1 equity.

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated they are looking to explore gold metal loans in this financial year for new gold buying for upcoming stores.
capital_allocation.quote: So we will be exploring GML in this financial year perhaps for buying -- the new buying of gold that will happen for the upcoming stores.

management_commitments.claim: The B2B to B2C revenue mix is targeted to become 50-50 in a year or two.
management_commitments.quote: the mix has to, I think the B2B to B2C mix has to be 50-50 or so in a year or two

Maninagar and Gandhinagar stores will be launched in Quarter 3.
management_commitments.quote: Maninagar and Gandhinagar both will be launched in Quarter 3 itself.

management_commitments.quote: I see by the end of this year, it will be at least 20% will be of 18 caratage.

management_commitments.quote: Targeting maximum utilisation of existing manufacturing capacity by FY26

management_commitments.claim: Both the Surat and Rajkot showrooms are targeted to commence operations by the second quarter of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: both the showrooms are targeted to commence operations by quarter 2 of FY27.
